card.canvas_label: Solar system on {date}. Drag to rotate or use the arrow keys. Ctrl + scroll or pinch to zoom.
card.zoom_hint: Hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom
card.readout_idle: Tap a planet to see how far away it is.
card.readout_planet: {name} is in {constellation}, {earth} from Earth and {sun} from the Sun. Its light takes {light} to reach you.
card.readout_earth: Earth is {sun} from the Sun. Sunlight takes {light} to get here.

eclipse.home_covered: From your home, the Moon covers up to {percent} of the Sun.
eclipse.home_annular: From your home, it's annular: a ring of Sun stays around the Moon.
eclipse.home_seen_lunar: You can see it from your home.
eclipse.home_sun_sets: From your home, the Sun sets while it's under way.
eclipse.home_sun_rises: From your home, the Sun rises while it's under way.
eclipse.home_moon_sets: From your home, the Moon sets while it's under way.
eclipse.home_moon_rises: From your home, the Moon rises while it's under way.
eclipse.home_unseen: It can't be seen from your home.

editor.title: Title
editor.title_helper: Optional. Leave it empty for no heading.
editor.scale_helper: Log fits every planet on the card. True to scale shows real distances, so you zoom in to see the inner planets.
editor.tilt_helper: 1 shows the real tilts, which are small. Higher values exaggerate them.
editor.color_theme_helper: HA theme uses your theme's primary and accent colors.
editor.show_pluto_helper: A dwarf planet. Its orbit reaches past Neptune's. If it runs off the card, zoom out.
editor.show_jupiter_moons_helper: Io, Europa, Ganymede and Callisto. Their distances are compressed so you can see them; their directions are real.
editor.show_home_helper: A line from Earth points at the sky straight above your home, as set in Home Assistant. Solid by day, dashed at night.
editor.show_eclipses_helper: Jump to the previous or next solar or lunar eclipse. Needs the time controls.
editor.ambient_motion_helper: Keeps the card moving. Turn it off to save power on wall tablets.
